# Lifecycle Safety Checklist: Run Lifecycle Kernel

**Purpose**: Formal PR-review gate for the completeness, clarity, consistency, and measurability of Run lifecycle, concurrency, budget, tenant, and safe-contract requirements
**Created**: 2026-08-24
**Feature**: [spec.md](../spec.md)

**Note**: This custom checklist is generated by the `$speckit-checklist` command based on feature context and requirements.
**Review Ownership**: This checklist is a reviewer-owned requirements-quality review artifact. Mark an item `[x]` only when the reviewer determines the requirements-quality criterion is satisfied.
**Marker Semantics**: `[x]` means the criterion has been reviewed and satisfied for requirements quality. It does not mean implementation work is complete.

## State Machine Completeness

- [x] CHK001 Are all eight Run states, four terminal states, and every allowed transition explicitly enumerated without a catch-all transition path? [Completeness, Spec §FR-003–FR-005]
- [x] CHK002 Are cancellation requirements defined for every non-terminal state, including both waiting states and queued? [Coverage, Spec §FR-004–FR-005]
- [x] CHK003 Are timeout/limit paths defined for queued, running, waiting_approval, and waiting_resolution so no non-terminal state can become permanent? [Recovery, Spec §FR-004, §FR-015]
- [x] CHK004 Is terminal immutability stated consistently for status, version, result, usage, and event history? [Consistency, Spec §US1/AC5, §FR-005, §FR-016]
- [x] CHK005 Are illegal-transition outcomes measurable and explicit about preserving state, version, result, budget, and events? [Clarity, Spec §US1/AC4, §FR-020]

## Idempotency and Concurrency

- [x] CHK006 Is command identity scoped unambiguously by tenant and separated from Run identity? [Clarity, Spec §FR-006–FR-010]
- [x] CHK007 Does the specification distinguish same-ID/same-intent replay, same-ID/different-intent conflict, and new-command/stale-version conflict? [Completeness, Spec §FR-007–FR-008]
- [x] CHK008 Is the ordering between idempotency replay detection and expected-version validation defined so lost-response retries are not rejected incorrectly? [Consistency, Plan §Design Decision 2]
- [x] CHK009 Are atomicity requirements explicit for the Run snapshot, appended events, and CommandReceipt, including the no-partial-write failure case? [Recovery, Spec §FR-009; Data Model §Repository Atomicity]
- [x] CHK010 Are concurrent same-version commands required to have at most one winner with an objective acceptance count? [Measurability, Spec §US2/AC3, §SC-003]
- [x] CHK011 Are duplicate-command requirements explicit that no second version increment, event, result, or budget charge is created? [Coverage, Spec §FR-007, §FR-020, §SC-004]
- [x] CHK012 Is reuse of a charge_id with changed dimensions handled consistently with command idempotency conflict semantics? [Consistency, Spec §Edge Cases, §FR-013]

## Budget and Cancellation Safety

- [x] CHK013 Are all required hard-budget dimensions listed and constrained as non-negative, finite, and non-increasing in authority? [Completeness, Spec §FR-011–FR-012]
- [x] CHK014 Is the exact boundary rule clear that equality is allowed while prospective excess terminates before new work starts? [Clarity, Spec §FR-014, §SC-005]
- [x] CHK015 Are confirmed usage, prospective assessment, and unknown/unconfirmed usage distinguished so estimates cannot be represented as actual consumption? [Clarity, Spec §Edge Cases; Plan §Design Decision 4]
- [x] CHK016 Is deadline behavior defined at the exact deadline and under a backward clock observation? [Edge Case, Spec §FR-015 and Edge Cases]
- [x] CHK017 Are requirements explicit that an over-limit candidate charge is not added to confirmed usage when the Run transitions to limit_exceeded? [Consistency, Contract §consume_budget]
- [x] CHK018 Are cancellation requirements clear about preserving already confirmed usage while forbidding all later work and state revival? [Coverage, Spec §US3/AC4 and Edge Cases]
- [x] CHK019 Is it clear whether waiting time counts toward the fixed deadline and which waiting states can terminate on deadline? [Clarity, Spec §FR-004, §FR-015]

## Events and Results

- [x] CHK020 Are event-envelope fields, sequence origin, continuity, payload version, and append-only behavior all explicitly specified? [Completeness, Spec §FR-018–FR-020]
- [x] CHK021 Is the one-event-per-successful-mutating-command rule consistent across create, transition, budget, and terminal commands? [Consistency, Plan §Design Decision 5]
- [x] CHK022 Are event requirements explicit that replay, validation failure, illegal transition, tenant miss, and concurrency conflict add zero events? [Exception Flow, Spec §FR-020, §SC-007]
- [x] CHK023 Are RunResult requirements complete for all four terminal states, including status/error consistency and a single immutable result? [Completeness, Spec §FR-016–FR-017, §SC-008]
- [x] CHK024 Are Citation, Artifact, and Approval values explicitly limited to references so later domain objects are not prematurely invented? [Scope, Spec §Assumptions]
- [x] CHK025 Is empty successful output distinguished from a failed result without permitting failure fields on succeeded? [Edge Case, Spec §Edge Cases, §FR-017]

## Tenant and Sensitive-Data Boundaries

- [x] CHK026 Are tenant requirements present for Run, command, receipt, event, repository load, commit, and event listing? [Coverage, Spec §FR-010; Data Model]
- [x] CHK027 Is cross-tenant behavior required to be indistinguishable from a genuinely missing Run for both reads and writes? [Security, Spec §US2/AC4, §FR-010]
- [x] CHK028 Are forbidden sensitive categories enumerated consistently for errors, event payloads, results, receipts, and printable representations? [Completeness, Spec §FR-021, §SC-009]
- [x] CHK029 Are safe error codes and messages specific enough to diagnose conflict class without echoing submitted identifiers or downstream bodies? [Clarity, Contract §Stable Error Contract]
- [x] CHK030 Are hidden reasoning and Provider/framework objects explicitly excluded from every stable domain and application contract? [Security, Spec §FR-021–FR-022]

## Scope, Replacement, and Acceptance

- [x] CHK031 Is the exclusion boundary explicit for PostgreSQL, migrations, leases, Worker, Reconciler, LangGraph, API/SSE, AgentSpec compilation, Approval/Tool execution, Context, Memory, RAG, and Langfuse? [Scope, Spec §FR-024]
- [x] CHK032 Is the in-memory adapter clearly described as contract-validation infrastructure rather than a production queue or persistence claim? [Assumption, Spec §Assumptions; Plan §Design Decision 3]
- [x] CHK033 Are requirements sufficient for a later PostgreSQL adapter to implement the same atomic port without changing domain semantics? [Extensibility, Spec §SC-012; Contract §RunRepository Port]
- [x] CHK034 Are all concurrency, idempotency, transition, budget, event, result, isolation, leakage, offline, and performance criteria objectively measurable? [Acceptance Criteria, Spec §SC-001–SC-012]
- [x] CHK035 Are rollback requirements complete and consistent with the no-migration/no-external-side-effect scope? [Recovery, Spec §FR-025; Plan §Failure, Security, Rollback, and Operations]

## Notes

- Reviewer approved all 35 requirements-quality criteria on 2026-08-24 and authorized implementation to continue.
- Depth: formal release gate for a high-risk domain/state-machine slice.
- Audience/timing: human reviewer before `$speckit-implement`.
- Focus: state correctness, atomic idempotency, hard-budget termination, tenant isolation, safe stable contracts, and replacement boundaries.
- Mark items `[x]` only after review confirms the requirement-quality criterion is satisfied.
- `$speckit-implement` reads this checklist as a gate and must not modify markers.
